reviewer: Kimi Code recovery review subagent; actually viewed the full exact source, complete unchanged raw, full white/cyan/source-alpha/return-alpha comparison sheet and naiwa reference, inspected native-resolution raw detail regions, and verified the recorded evidence, source PNG, output, task, prompt, request, result and sheet SHA-256 values plus image metadata with read-only Python.

entries.positive_observation: The compact yellow mascot has green-ringed solid black eyes, thick brown eyebrows, one short full brown moustache across the upper lip and exactly one closed mouth beneath it, with no second lip, beard, glasses, human skin, nose or ears. Short brown sideburns remain beside the covered hairline and the chin is visibly smooth. The dark olive peaked cap retains its dark brown band, gold eagle, gold wreath/cockade, braided cords/piping, shiny black visor and gold embroidery as visible principal groups. The near-frontal square-shouldered composition, direct stern gaze, soft frontal light and cap shadow remain. The dark olive uniform retains red gold-embroidered collar tabs, gold shoulder boards, one black-and-white neck cross and the multicolored ribbon bar in the lower-chest crop without visible group duplication. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a neck column, pinching, floating cloth or cream bib. The pale grey-beige backplate remains complete and opaque across the full canvas with its warm center and muted edge shading; no frame, note, cutout or halo was added. Full raw and white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes or backing loss.
entries.alpha_decision: RGB art is approved, but production use still requires the frozen request's separate source-alpha BILINEAR restoration without changing RGB. The source is fully opaque RGBA with measured extrema [255,255], and the unchanged raw is RGB with returned_alpha_extrema null. Full raw and white/cyan/source-alpha comparisons show no visible holes or backing loss. This is an approval for the source-compatible alpha-only step only; that repair was not performed and the raw is not marked production-ready.
entries.visible_limitations: Individual ribbon-bar cells and the tiniest cap, collar and lower-chest decoration details cannot be transcribed reliably at 156x210. In particular, the extreme bottom source crop does not securely separate any additional clipped lower-decoration marks from fabric shading, so no exact presence, absence or microscopic match is claimed for those marks. Approval covers the actually visible feature and decoration groups, counts and placements; no decision is based on those tiny ambiguities.
